Submission Instructions

  1. Transcribe your page by hand as a diplomatic transcription in ground_truth.txt (or .xml): keep the original spelling, mark each line with <lb n="..."/>, and mark what you cannot read with <unclear/>.
  2. Run the same page through Transkribus or an AI model.
  3. In the online text box, paste the machine output and write a short comparison (no minimum length) of where it differs from your reading and why ground truth matters.
